name: Il Lombardia
story: After numerous attacks, a 12-rider breakaway formed, later reduced to seven. A strong pace in the peloton kept the race together until the penultimate climb, where Paul Seixas accelerated. He caught the breakaway and dropped his rivals one by one, securing victory with a dominant solo ride to become the youngest-ever winner of Il Lombardia. Enric Mas finished second, ahead of Giulio Ciccone
